[SWS_DM_00270] Counting of attempts to change security level
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04005
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall count the number of failed attempts to
change a requested security level. The Counter shall be reset if the security level
change has passed successfully.
⌋
